The amount of time in seconds or milliseconds that a person took to give an initial response, a first attempt to answer a formative assessment item.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Hint Count

The total number of hints presented as the learner responded to a formative assessment item.  This may include hints requested by the learner or hints automatically presented such as in an online tutoring system. Presentation of a scaffolding item is a separate response record and not counted as a hint.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Score Value
The score given to a person's response to an assessment item.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Security Issue
The description of security issue, if any, related to a learner's response to an assessment item.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Start Date
The date on which the assessment item was presented to the learner.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Start Time
The time of day that the assessment item was presented to the learner.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Response Value
A specific response to an assessment item by the person being assessed.
Assessment Item Response.Assessment Item Result XML
The  assessment item result formatted according to the IMS Global QTI  Specification.
Assessment Item Response.Has Assessment Item Response Hint Included Answer
Indicates that one of the hints presented included the correct answer.
Assessment Item Response.Has Assessment Item Response Scaffolding Item Flag

Indicates that the response is to a scaffolding problem rather than the main/assigned problem.  A scaffolding item is a follow-up formative assessment item used to assess prerequisite or component skills, presented immediately after a learner gives an incorrect answer on the previous item.
Assessment Item Response.Has Assessment Item Response Score Status
The status of scoring a person's response to an assessment item.
Assessment Item Response.Has Assessment Item Response Status
The status of the response for a given item.
Assessment Item Response.Has Assessment Item Rubric Criterion Result
References information about an assessment result or score derived using a rubic criterion.

References information about clickstream data for online assessments and other experiences such as is used by intelligent tutoring systems. The model is compatible with the structure of data found in Experience API (xAPI) specification.
An indication of whether a student's scores were proficient.
The amount of time allotted for a specific item.
The complete text of an assessment item including all applicable parts such as stimulus, stem, and possible response options presented.
The percentage of students who answered the item correctly during trial testing of the item.
The analysis of the distractors provided for a specific assessment.
The identifier that uniquely identifies an assessment item.
The maximum number of points possible for the assessment item.
The minimum number of points possible for the assessment item.
The statement of the question or prompt for an Assessment Item to which the student responds.
The text, source (e.g., video clip), and/or graphic about which the assessment item is written. The stimulus provides the context of the item/task to which the student must respond.
Assessment Item.Assessment Item Text Complexity Value
The complexity of the text using the scaling system defined by Text Complexity System, e.g. Lexile� for assessment items with a reading passage.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Form Section Item Field Test Indicator
Indicates that the assessment item is being field tested on this form of the test, and is not to be included for scoring.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Adaptive Indicator
This indicator determines whether an assessment item is an adaptive item.
References accessible Portable Item Protocol information for an assessment item that may use the IMS Global APIP(R) standards.
References the type and value for a psychometric measure.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Interaction Type
The assessment item body interaction type as defined by IMS Global specifications.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Linking Item Indicator
Indicates that the item is intended to be administered in two different grades for the goal of establishing cross grade comparison.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Possible Response
References information about one of the possible responses that a person may give in response to an assessment item prompt.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Release Status
Indicates that the assessment item has been released to the public.

References information about a learner response and subsequent information about feedback and scoring of the response. Some properties like DescriptiveFeedback are for support of a formative assessment process. Some properties are used within intelligent tutoring systems such as HintCount and ScaffoldingItemFlag.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Response Theory

References information representing the difficulty of an assessment itme and other measures of the relationship between any individuals' performances on the test item and the test takers' levels of performance on an overall measure of the ability that item was designed to measure.
Assessment Item.Has Assessment Item Text Complexity System
The scaling system used to specify the text complexity of an assessment item.
The specific type of assessment item.
Assessment Item.Has NAEP Aspects of Reading
Aspects of reading defined by the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP 2005b Framework).
Assessment Item.Has NAEP Mathematical Complexity Level
Complexity levels defined by the National Assessment of Educational Progress (NAEP 2005a Framework).
References a set of criteria or indicators that assist in determining whether an entity possesses a given competence or level of performance in a task or work product.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Alternative Representation Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default presentation mode of the associated Alternative Representations accessibility.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Directions Only
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile whether or not the verbal alternative content presentation should be applied to directive content only.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Item Translation Display Language Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default language for the displayed translation.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Keyword Translation Language Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the default language for the keyword translation.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Read at Start Preference
Used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define if the spoken play-back should commence from the start of a recording or not.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Signing Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the type of signing preferred by the user.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need Spoken Source Preference Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred spoken audio form.
Assessment Need Apip Content.Has Assessment Need User Spoken Preference Type
Used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the type of material that should be rendered using the read aloud alternative content.
Assessment Need Apip Control.Assessment Need Background Color
This is the preferred Background color for screen enhancement defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.
Assessment Need Apip Control.Assessment Need Line Reader Highlight Color
The color defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to be used to highlight the point of line reader activity i.e. the line being read.
Assessment Need Apip Control.Assessment Need Overlay Color
This is the preferred color for the overlay for screen enhancement defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.
Assessment Need Apip Control.Assessment Need Time Multiplier

Defines the multiplier to be applied to the time limit to determine the total testing time allowed when Additional Testing Time is specified as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.  If the value is 'unlimited' then there is no time limit for the test.
Assessment Need Apip Control.Has Assessment Need Increased Whitespacing Type
Defines the user preferences for white spacing in lines, words and characters as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.
Assessment Need Apip Display.Assessment Need Sound File URL

The URI of the sound file that is to be played to the user as an expression of encouragement when Masking is specified as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile. It is left to the system to determine when to play this audio file.
Assessment Need Apip Display.Assessment Need Text Messaging String

The text string that is to be displayed to the user as an expression of encouragement when Masking is specified as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.  It is left to the system to determine when to display this string.
Assessment Need Apip Display.Has Assessment Need Masking Type
Specifies as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the type of masks the user is able to create  to cover portions of the question until needed.
Assessment Need Apip Display.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Activate by Default
Determines if the alternative accessible content is rendered as the default content for the learner.
Assessment Need Apip Display.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Assigned Support
Defines whether or not the individual needs the kind of support defined by the entity.
Assessment Need Braille.Assessment Need Braille Dot Pressure
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the resistance pressure of Braille display pins.
Assessment Need Braille.Assessment Need Number of Braille Cells
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the number of active Braille cells in a Braille display.
Assessment Need Braille.Has Assessment Need Braille Grade Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the grade of Braille to use when using a Braille display.
Assessment Need Braille.Has Assessment Need Braille Mark Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile what textual properties to mark when using a Braille display.
Assessment Need Braille.Has Assessment Need Braille Status Cell Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred presence or location of a Braille display status cell.
Assessment Need Braille.Has Assessment Need Number of Braille Dots Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the number of dots in a Braille cell.
Assessment Need Braille.Has Assessment Need Usage Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the rating for the collection of Access for All (AfA) needs and preferences.
Assessment Need Screen Enhancement.Assessment Need Foreground Color
This is the preferred Foreground color for screen enhancement defined as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile.
Assessment Need Screen Enhancement.Assessment Need Magnification
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the preferred magnification of the screen as a factor of a screen's original size.
Assessment Need Screen Enhancement.Has Assessment Need Invert Color Choice
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the Access for All (AfA) preference to invert the foreground and background Colors.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Participant Session Database Name
The name of the database that was used to administer the test.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Participant Session Delivery Device Details
The details about the device or platform by with which the assessment was delivered to the learner.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Participant Session Platform User Agent
A list of product tokens (keywords) with optional comments that identifies the client hardware and software with which the assessment was delivered to the student during the assessment session.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Participant Session Security Issue
Describes an issue related to the security of a testing instrument identified during a specific instance of delivering an assessment to a specific person during a specific time period.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Participant Session Time Assessed
The overall time a learner actually spent during the  assessment session.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Session Actual End Date Time
Date and time the assessment actually ended.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Session Actual Start Date Time
Date and time the assessment actually began.
Assessment Participant Session.Assessment Session Special Event Description
Describes special events that occur before during or after the assessment session that may impact use of results according to rules related to the Assessment Registration Testing Indicator.

References information defining the type of design elements or functionalities integrated into products, services, or environments to ensure equitable access for all individuals, aiming to eliminate barriers and facilitate ease of use.
Assessment Participant Session.Has Assessment Participant Session Language
The language that the assessment is administered.
Assessment Participant Session.Has Assessment Participant Session Platform Type
The platform with which the assessment was delivered to the student during the assessment session.
Assessment Participant Session.Has Assessment Session Special Circumstance Type
An unusual event occurred during the administration of the assessment. This could include fire alarm, student became ill, etc.
Assessment Participant Session.Has Assessment Session Staff Role
References roles served related to the administration of an assessment session.
Assessment Performance Level.Assessment Performance Level Descriptive Feedback
A feedback message designed to be reported with the assessment performance level.
Assessment Performance Level.Assessment Performance Level Identifier
A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment performance level.
Assessment Performance Level.Assessment Performance Level Label
A label representing the performance level appropriate for use on a report.
Assessment Performance Level.Assessment Performance Level Lower Cut Score
Lowest possible score for the performance level.
Assessment Performance Level.Assessment Performance Level Upper Cut Score
Highest possible score for the performance level.
Assessment Performance Level.Has Assessment Performance Level Score Metric
The metric or scale used for score reporting.
Assessment Personal Need Language Learner.Has Assessment Need Language Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile a preference for the language of the user interface.
Assessment Personal Need Screen Reader.Assessment Need Pitch
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the pitch of a speech synthesizer.
Assessment Personal Need Screen Reader.Assessment Need Speech Rate
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the rate of speech of a speech synthesizer.
Assessment Personal Need Screen Reader.Assessment Need Volume
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the volume of a speech synthesizer.
Assessment Personal Need Screen Reader.Has Assessment Need Link Indication Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the characteristics of presentation for a hyperlink when using a screen reader.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Content.Has Assessment Need Apip Content
References information used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the content preferences and representation.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Content.Has Assessment Need Hazard Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile a characteristic of a digital resource that may be specified as being dangerous to a user.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Content.Has Assessment Need Support Tool Type
Defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the electronic tool associated with a resource.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Content.Has Assessment Personal Need Language Learner
References information that indicates a person's need related as a language learner that may be used to deternine the need for an assessment accomodation.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Control.Has Assessment Need Apip Control
References information used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the control attributes.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Display.Has Assessment Need Apip Display
References information used as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile to define the display attributes.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Display.Has Assessment Need Braille
References information that defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the attributes for Braille display
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Display.Has Assessment Need Screen Enhancement
References defines as part of an Assessment Personal Needs Profile the attributes for screen enhancement.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile Display.Has Assessment Personal Need Screen Reader
References information that indicates a person's need that calls for use of a screen reader accomodation during assessment.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile.Assessment Need Type
A type of need identified for a learner as part of an assessment need profile.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Content
References an entity that includes information about the personal needs and preferences related to content presented within an assessment delivery.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Control
References an entity that includes information about the personal needs and preferences related to control of presentation during delivery of assessments.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Display
References an entity that includes information about the personal needs and preferences related to displays of assessment content.
Assessment Personal Needs Profile.Has Assessment Personal Needs Profile Screen Enhancement
References an entity that includes information about the personal needs and preferences related to screen enhancements during delivery of an assessment.
The unique identifier of the person who assigned the assessment to the learner.
Assessment Registration.Assessment Registration Completion Status Date Time
The date and time the completion and scoring status was changed for an instance of a person taking an assessment.
Assessment Registration.Assessment Registration Days of Instruction
The number of days of instruction the student has taken prior to testing.
Assessment Registration.Assessment Registration Score Publish Date

The date set by the testing program when the test scores are published.  For formative or classroom assessments, this will likely be the date when the scored the individual test.  For summative assessments, this date is likely set for a group of assessments when the processing system releases the scores.
Assessment Registration.Assessment Registration Test Attempt Identifier
A unique identifier for the test attempt assigned by the delivery system.
Indicates rules about use of results based on Special Events before, during or after the test. The option set values are determined by the testing program.
References information for an assessment event or administration period.
References information about a specific person's participation in an Assessment Session.
Assessment Registration.Has Assessment Registration Completion Status
The completion and scoring status for an instance of a person taking an assessment.
Assessment Registration.Has Assessment Registration Grade Level to Be Assessed
The grade or level at which the learner is to be assessed.
Assessment Registration.Has Assessment Registration Participation Indicator
An indication of whether a student participated in an assessment.
Assessment Registration.Has Assessment Registration Reason Not Completing
The primary reason a participant did not complete an assessment.
Assessment Registration.Has Assessment Registration Retest Indicator
Indicates if this registration is for a retest (retake). Retest can occur if a student failed a prior attempt and is eligible to retake. Other retest scenarios also can occur.

References an entity that includes information about a person's results from an assessment which may be for the entire assessment or one aspect of evaluation. The scoring method is defined by the related Assessment Subtest. The entity includes the score value and information about the score, such as a diagnostic statement.
Assessment Registration.Has Grade Level When Assessed
The grade or developmental level of a student when assessed.
Assessment Registration.Has LEA Full Academic Year
An indication of whether a student was in membership in the LEA education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.
The primary reason a student is not tested.
Assessment Registration.Has School Full Academic Year
An indication of whether a student was in membership in the school education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.
Assessment Registration.Has State Full Academic Year
An indication of whether a student was in membership in the state education unit for a full academic year, according to the state's definition of Full Academic Year.
The date on which the assessment result was generated.

The most recent date that the result was calculated/updated.  The value should be the same as Assessment Result Date Created if the subtest has only been scored once, but may be different if the score was recalculated with a different result.
The formative descriptive feedback that was given to a learner based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment as recorded in the result entity.
Assessment Result.Assessment Result Descriptive Feedback Date Time
The date and time the descriptive feedback was entered for a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.
Assessment Result.Assessment Result Descriptive Feedback Source

Identifies the source of the descriptive feedback that was given to a learner based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment. May indicate if this is teacher, scorer, or system generated feedback. Values for this attribute would be determined by the assessment program.

A statement intended for use by education professionals, using professional terminology, to interpret learner needs based on the scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.  This statement may inform Descriptive Feedback given to the learner.
Assessment Result.Assessment Result Number of Responses

The number of responses that are included with the Student Score Set. Responses are those items that were attempted (partially or fully answered) by the student and not necessarily the number of items in the assessment (which can be determined from the assessment object).

A meaningful raw score, derived score, or statistical expression of the performance of a person on an assessment. The type of result is indicated by the Assessment Score Metric Type element. The results can be expressed as a number, percentile, range, level, etc. The score relates to all scored items or a sub test scoring one aspect of performance on the test. This value may or may not correspond to one or more Performance Levels.
Assessment Result.Assessment Result Score Value Standard Error
The measure of sampling variability and measurement error for the score, the amount of error to be expected in the score.
Identifies the source of the Diagnostic Statement based on a scored/evaluated portion of an assessment.
Assessment Result.Early Learning Outcome Measurement Date
The date on which the assessment is conducted to determine the outcome.

References information about the performance levels that may be assigned to an Assessment Subtest Result and specifications for selecting the performance level based on a score. Four styles are supported: 1) specification of performance level by lower and upper cut score, 2) specification of performance level by lower cut score only, 3) specification of performance level without any mapping to scores, and 4) Specification of performance level by mapping to other scores.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Result Data Type
The data type of the assessment result score value.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Result Preliminary Indicator
If this score is preliminary, then this attribute value should be set.  Preliminary scores may be provided for early use by the assessment program or user while final scoring is occurring.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Result Pretest Outcome
The results of a pre-test in academic subjects.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Result Rubric Criterion Result
References information that links an assessment result record to a result defined within a RubricCriterion.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Result Score Type
Indicates the purpose for which this assessment score instance was recorded.
Assessment Result.Has Assessment Score Metric Type
The specific method used to report the performance and achievement of the assessment. This is the metric that is being used to derive the scores.
Assessment Result.Has Early Learning Outcome Measurement Level
Use for outcome measures in early learning.
Assessment Result.Has Early Learning Outcome Time Point
The point in time for which the result is used for an outcome measure.
The measurement scale or level of measurement for a variable.
This provides the next steps for instruction for the student based upon the assessment results and student characteristics.
Assessment Session Staff Role.Has Assessment Session Staff Role Type
The type of role served related to the administration of an assessment session.
The duration of time allotted for the assessment session.
The description of the place where an assessment is administered.
Assessment Session.Assessment Session Scheduled End Date Time
Date and time the assessment is scheduled to end.
Assessment Session.Assessment Session Scheduled Start Date Time
Date and time the assessment is scheduled to begin.
The description of a security issue, if any, discovered for an administration of an assessment, such as suspected cheating by a student or a teacher changing answers after a student takes the test.
The type of session that is scheduled.
Assessment Subtest Assessment Item.Assessment Form Subtest Item Weight Correct

A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item is correct or partially correct. Item weight of 1 indicates the full item score is used. A weight of .5 would indicate the item only contributes one half of the item score to the subtest. A weight of 0 indicates the item does not affect the sub test score.
Assessment Subtest Assessment Item.Assessment Form Subtest Item Weight Incorrect

A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item is attempted and incorrect. Item weight should be a negative value if the item subtracts from the score if missed.
Assessment Subtest Assessment Item.Assessment Form Subtest Item Weight Not Attempted

A weighting factor for how the item score is used to compute a sub-test score when the item has not been attempted by the student. Item weight should be a negative value if the item subtracts from the score if not attempted.
In a hierarchy of subtests, this element represents the level of the sub test in the hierarchy.  The top tier and default is zero.
The shortened name identifying the assessment for use in reference and/or reports.
The description of the subtest (e.g., vocabulary, measurement, or geometry).
A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment subtest.
The maximum value for the measurement.
The minimum value possible for the measurement.
The optimal value for this measurement.
The date on which the Subtest was published.
A description of the rules to produce a student test/subtest score from for a grouping of student item scores.
The name or title of the subtest.
The version of the subtest that is included for the assessment.
Assessment Subtest.Has Assessment Content Standard Type
An indication as to whether an assessment conforms to a standard.
Assessment Subtest.Has Assessment Form Subtest Container Only
In a hierarchy of subtests, this indicates that this tier is only used as a level in the hierarchy and does not represent a scoring model.

References information for scoring an Assessment Form based on a set of Assessment Item responses with explicit rules to produce an Assessment Subtest Result, which may be for the entire Assessment Form or one aspect of evaluation based on a subset of Assessment Items.
Assessment Subtest.Has Assessment Subtest Assessment Item
References information linking assessment subtest to an assessment item.
Assessment Subtest.Has Assessment Subtest Early Learning Developmental Domain
References developmental domains related to early learning and used for assessing a child's kindergarten readiness.
Assessment Subtest.Has Assessment Subtest Identifier Type
The type of identifier that is provided for a Subtest.

References a resource that states a capability or behavior that a person may learn or be able to do within a given context with references to potential levels of competence, a mastery threshold, and other contextualizing metadata.
The title of the assessment family to be administered.
The abbreviated title of the Assessment Family. An Assessment Family is a set of assessments with a common name, jurisdiction, or focus.

The full title of the Assessment Family. An Assessment Family is a set of assessments with a common name, jurisdiction, or focus, such as Graduate Record Exam or National Assessment of Educational Progress.
A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to an assessment by a school, school system, a state, or other agency or entity.  This may be the publisher identifier.
This is the objective that the assessment is measuring.
Identifies the provider or publisher of the assessment.
The month, day, and year that the conceptual design for the assessment was most recently revised substantially.
An abbreviated title for an assessment.
The title or name of the assessment.
The description of the academic content or subject area (e.g., arts, mathematics, reading, or a foreign language) being evaluated.
Assessment.Has Assessment Early Learning Developmental Domain
Developmental domains related to early learning and used for assessing a child's kindergarten readiness.
References an instance of an assessment that can equate scores with another instance of that same assessment.
A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes by schools, social services, or other agencies to refer to an assessment.
The language in which the assessment form is designed to be delivered.
Assessment.Has Assessment Level for Which Designed
The typical grade or combination of grade-levels, developmental levels, or age-levels for which an assessment is designed.
The reason for which an assessment is designed or delivered.
The category of an assessment based on format and content.
Assessment.Has Assessment Type Administered to English Learners
The types of assessments administered to English Learners.
The specific grade level or combination of grade levels.
The code for the specific language or dialect that a person uses to communicate.
The code for the specific language or dialect that a person uses to communicate.
The language family per ISO 639-5 associated with the language entity.
The last year, month and day on which the assignment is valid.
The year, month and day from which the assignment is valid.
The type of position the staff member holds in the specific course section.
The role that the Staff Member has been assigned for a Class Section.  (A teacher may have the lead responsibility for one section and serve a supporting role for another section of the same course.)
A percentage used to weight the educator's assigned responsibility for student learning in a Class Section, particularly when more than one educator is assigned to the class section.
The year, month and day on which a teaching assignment ends.
The year, month and day on which a teaching assignment begins.
The date after which the  an associated person is no longer allowed to use the specified Authentication Identity Provider to authenticate identity.
The login identifier for the person for the specified Authentication Identity Provider.
The name of a provider that can authenticate the identity of an person.
The date on which the  an associated person may begin to use the specified Authentication Identity Provider to authenticate identity.
The Uniform Resource Identifier (URI) of the  Authentication Identity Provider.
Authorizer's explanation regarding the authorization decision.
Indicates authorizer agreement to a document or plan, such as plan for delivery of student services, program, or improvement plan.
Type of person who authorized the decision or document.
The user role for which the person is allowed.
The date after which the  an associated person is no longer allowed to use the application with the specified role.
The date on which the  an associated person  is authorized to start using the application with the specified role.

References data collections track the details of data submissions as part of an organized, time-bound collection event, typically governed by specific deadlines and requirements, to ensure accurate and timely data reporting in a structured system.
Base CEDS Resource.Has Record Reference Identification System
A coding scheme that is used for identification and record-keeping purposes to refer to a record.

References a classification representing the current condition, lifecycle stage, or operational state of a data record, including associated key dates, committing organization, committing individual, and statuses.
Base CEDS Resource.Record End Date Time
The end date and, optionally, time that a record is active as used to support version control.
A unique number or alphanumeric code assigned to a record.
Base CEDS Resource.Record Start Date Time
The start date and, optionally, time that a record is active as used to support version control.
Board Membership.Board Member Term End Date
The date on which the board member's term ends.
Board Membership.Board Member Term Start Date
The date on which the board member's term begins.
Board Membership.Has Board Member Position Type
The position or role the person performs on the board.
The type of membership for the board member.
Building Space Utilization.Building Space Utilization Area

The area in square feet measured between the principal wall that faces at or near floor level, including alcove spaces, and the outer limits of space designed to serve the activity. Structural space is excluded.
Building Space Utilization.Has Available Utilized Instructional Space
An indication that the instruction space in a school is used in the calculation of student capacity.
Building Space Utilization.Has Building Capacity Factor Indicator
A designation as to whether the space is included in the calculation of school building capacity under state or local guidelines.
Building Space Utilization.Has Building Community Use Space Type
The space designed primarily for community or shared use.
Building Space Utilization.Has Building Instructional Space Factor Type
A designation as to whether the space is considered an instructional space under state or local guidelines.
Building Space Utilization.Has Building Unassigned Space Indicator
An indication that the space in a school, including circulation, administration offices, support spaces, and common areas, is not part of the calculation for capacity.
A description of the space, as determined by its physical layout and built-in systems and equipment.
Building Space.Has Building Administrative Space Type
The space designed primarily for conducting administrative and business functions.
Building Space.Has Building Art Specialty Space Type
The space designed to support the teaching and learning of 2 dimensional or 3 dimensional visual arts.
Building Space.Has Building Assembly Space Type
An area designed primarily for theater productions, assemblies, and other large gatherings.
Building Space.Has Building Basic Classroom Design Type
A classroom designed for instruction of a particular age group, but not a specific subject.
Building Space.Has Building Career-Technical Education Space Type

The classroom, laboratory, or shop specially located, designed, furnished, and equipped to support instruction of technical and technology related curriculum, usually tied to particular industry, for example, bio-tech, construction, or agriculture.
Building Space.Has Building Circulation Space Type
A space designed to enable people to move within the building.
Building Space.Has Building Food Service Space Type
The space located, designed, furnished and equipped to support meal programs.
Building Space.Has Building Full Service Kitchen Type
The type of kitchen housed in the facility as defined by whether it prepares food to be served onsite and/or at additional locations.
Building Space.Has Building Indoor Athletic or Physical Education Space Type
The indoor space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of a physical education curriculum and athletic program.
Building Space.Has Building Library or Media Center Specialty Space Type
The primary and auxiliary space designed to provide and support student and staff access to books, periodicals, software, videos, and the Internet.
Building Space.Has Building Operations or Maintenance Space Type
The area designed primarily for conducting activities concerned with maintaining the grounds, buildings, and equipment.
Building Space.Has Building Outdoor Athletic or Physical Education Space Type
The outdoor space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of a physical education curriculum and athletic program.
Building Space.Has Building Outdoor or Non-athletic Space Type
The outdoor space located, designed, furnished, and equipped primarily for recreation, play and outdoor environmental education.
Building Space.Has Building Performing Arts Specialty Space Type
The space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and support of music and drama curricula and productions.
Building Space.Has Building Science Specialty Space Type
The space designed, located, furnished, and equipped for instruction and experimentation in science.
Building Space.Has Building Space Design Type

It is a three-digit code with the format 00X. The first two digits identify the particular funding source, authority, or expenditure purpose for which a special record or report is required. The third digit is available to identify particular projects and the fiscal year of the appropriation within that funding source. Each classification is presented by a code range followed by a description.
The unique five-digit number assigned to each federal program as listed in the Assistance Listings. See https://sam.gov/content/assistance-listings

Such financial statements only report assets, deferred outflows of resources, liabilities, deferred inflows of resources, and equity accounts and are considered "snapshots" of how these accounts stand as of a certain point in time.

IPEDS Finance.Has IPEDS Finance GASB Functional Expense Category

A functional expense classification is a method of grouping expenses according to the purpose for which the costs are incurred. The classifications tell why an expense was incurred rather than what was purchased.

Location Address.Has Economic Research Service Rural-Urban Continuum Code

Rural-Urban Continuum Codes form a classification scheme that distinguishes metropolitan (metro) counties by the population size of their metro area, and nonmetropolitan (nonmetro) counties by degree of urbanization and adjacency to a metro area or areas. The metro and nonmetro categories have been subdivided into three metro and six nonmetro groupings, resulting in a nine-part county codification. The codes allow researchers working with county data to break such data into finer residential groups beyond a simple metro-nonmetro dichotomy, particularly for the analysis of trends in nonmetro areas that may be related to degree of rurality and metro proximity.

Person Status.Has Homeless Unaccompanied Youth Status

A homeless unaccompanied youth is a youth who is not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian and who fits the McKinney-Vento definition of homeless.  Students must be both unaccompanied and homeless to be included as unaccompanied homeless youth. There is no age range specified for an unaccompanied youth in the law. The upper age range is determined by what a state defines as school age, unless the child is in special education. The upper age range for students in special education may extend to 22 years of age. There is no lower age range. Therefore, as an example, a young child not in the physical custody of a parent or guardian, though living with a caregiver, and is living in a situation that is not fixed, regular, and adequate, would be identified as a homeless unaccompanied youth.

Faculty may also include the chancellor/president, provost, vice provosts, deans, directors or the equivalent, as well as associate deans, assistant deans and executive officers of academic departments (chairpersons, heads or the equivalent) if their principal activity is instruction combined with research and/or public service. The designation as "faculty" is separate from the activities to which they may be currently assigned. For example, a newly appointed president of an institution may also be appointed as a faculty member. Graduate, instruction, and research assistants are not included in this category.
